evals.prompt: Generate a signed embed URL for dashboard '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_EMBED}}' for user {{EVAL_EMBED_USER}} (display name 'Jane Doe'). The user should only see data for the Acme brand.
evals.expected_output: embedSsoDashboard called with correct contentId, externalId, name, and userAttributes for row-level security. Host is bare hostname only.
assertions: The agent uses embedSsoDashboard from @omni-co/embed — not a manual URL construction or signing
The host parameter is a bare hostname (e.g., yourorg.embed-omniapp.co) with no protocol prefix (https://) and no port
The userAttributes parameter includes the brand filter as an array value (e.g., { brand: ['Acme'] })
The agent uses the .embed-omniapp.co domain for the embed URL, not .omniapp.co

evals.prompt: Add event handling to an embedded dashboard so that when a user drills on a tile, the parent app logs the drilled row data.
evals.expected_output: postMessage listener added that filters for source: 'omni', handles the dashboard:tile-drill event, and accesses drill.rowToDrill from the payload.
assertions: The event listener checks event.data.source === 'omni' before processing any event
The handler specifically listens for the dashboard:tile-drill event name
The code accesses drill.rowToDrill from the event payload to get the drilled row data
The agent does not listen for all postMessage events indiscriminately — it filters by source

evals.prompt: Build a permission-aware sidebar that shows only the dashboards that embed user {{EVAL_EMBED_USER}} has access to.
evals.expected_output: Embed user looked up by externalId, then documents listed filtered to that user's permissions. Only documents with hasDashboard: true included. Identifiers used for embed signing.
assertions: The agent looks up the embed user with omni scim embed-users-list --filter 'embedExternalId eq "{{EVAL_EMBED_USER}}"' to get the Omni user ID
The agent calls omni documents list --userid with the retrieved user ID — not with the email directly
The agent filters results to only documents where hasDashboard: true before presenting them as embeddable
The agent uses the API domain (.omniapp.co) for the documents list call — not the embed domain (.embed-omniapp.co)

evals.prompt: Apply a custom theme to an embedded dashboard that matches our brand: dark red primary color (#E60000), light red background (#FEF2F2), and white button text.
evals.expected_output: customTheme object passed to embedSsoDashboard with dashboard-key-color, dashboard-background, and dashboard-key-text-color set to correct hex values.
assertions: The customTheme is passed as a parameter to embedSsoDashboard — not applied via CSS or injected into the iframe separately
dashboard-key-color is set to #E60000, dashboard-background to #FEF2F2, and dashboard-key-text-color to #ffffff
The theme uses solid hex color values — not linear-gradient() or rgba() for background properties
